appliesTo: Applies to {{server}}. To change another server, make it active on the Servers page.
loadFailed: Couldn't load how PanelBridge is installed
unexpectedResponse: The panel returned an unexpected response. Reload the page, and update the panel if it keeps happening.
refreshFailed: Couldn't refresh this status. What's shown may be out of date.
needsServerControl: Starting or restarting the server requires the server.control permission, which this role doesn't have.

local.title: Installed by the panel
local.lead: The panel copies PanelBridge into this server's game folder and keeps it up to date before every start.
local.pro1: Works with servers that launch without Steam.
local.pro2: Updates arrive with panel updates. Players download nothing.
local.con1: Players can only join while the Lua integrity check (DoLuaChecksum) is off.
local.con2: Hosted and SFTP servers need a manual re-upload after each panel update.

workshop.title: Steam Workshop
workshop.lead: The server downloads PanelBridge from the Steam Workshop when it starts. Players get it when they join.
workshop.pro1: Lets you turn the Lua integrity check back on.
workshop.pro2: Hosted servers need no file uploads, just two entries in the server settings.
workshop.con1: The server must run in Steam mode (Build 42).
workshop.con2: After each PanelBridge update on the Workshop, new players can't join until the server restarts.
workshop.con3: If Steam can't deliver PanelBridge, the server won't start. You can switch back here at any time.
workshop.players: Players see “Zomboid Control Panel Bridge” in the server's mod list and install it with one click when they join.

security.sentence: Turns the Lua integrity check back on: players whose Lua, script or animation files differ from the server's are refused. It doesn't stop modified game clients, and admin accounts skip this check.

checksumOff.title: The Lua integrity check is off.
checksumOff.body: With the panel-installed bridge it has to stay off, so this server doesn't compare players' Lua, script and animation files with its own, and a player with modified Lua files can join. Steam Workshop delivery lets you turn the check back on.

playersBlocked.title: Players can't join this server right now
playersBlocked.body: The Lua integrity check (DoLuaChecksum) is on, and the panel-installed PanelBridge adds server-side Lua files players don't have. Turn the check off, or switch to Steam Workshop delivery.

unavailable.notPublished: Not available yet: the PanelBridge Workshop item hasn't been published, so this panel version doesn't know its ID. A panel update will turn this on.
unavailable.idInvalid: This panel's Workshop item ID is invalid. Reinstall or update the panel.
unavailable.noSteam: This server launches without Steam (GOG/LAN). Workshop items can't download in that mode.
unavailable.noSteamShared: This server or one that shares its game folder ({{servers}}) launches without Steam (GOG/LAN). Workshop items can't download in that mode.
unavailable.gameVersionUnsupported: The PanelBridge Workshop item is for Build 42. This server reports {{version}}.
unavailable.iniNotFound: Start the server once so it creates its settings file, then switch.
unavailable.iniDuplicateKeys: The settings file has Mods= or WorkshopItems= twice. Fix it in Server Config › INI (raw) first.
unavailable.sameMethod: This server already uses this method.

warn.serverRunning: Takes effect when the server restarts.
warn.customLauncher: This server uses its own launch script. If that script starts the server without Steam, PanelBridge won't download.
warn.customLauncherShared: This server or one that shares its game folder ({{servers}}) uses its own launch script. If that script starts the server without Steam, PanelBridge won't download.
warn.sharedInstall: Servers that share this game folder switch too: {{servers}}.
warn.gameVersionUnknown: The panel can't confirm this server runs Build 42 yet. Connect PanelBridge once, or make sure it does.
warn.previewItem: Preview: not yet verified on a live server by the maintainer.
warn.siblingIniMissing: A server that shares this game folder has no settings file yet. The panel adds its entries the next time it starts that server.
warn.unrecognizedLooseFile: A PanelBridge file in the game folder wasn't written by this panel. It's moved out too and kept in the panel's data folder.
warn.checksumWillBeTurnedOff: The Lua integrity check will be turned off: players can't join with the panel-installed bridge while it's on.

local-ok.title: Installed in the game folder
local-ok.bodyGuided: PanelBridge v{{version}} is running on this server.
local-ok.bodyGuidedNoVersion: PanelBridge is running on this server.
local-ok.restartToLoad: The running server still reports v{{running}}. It loads v{{version}} when it restarts.

local-update-pending.title: Update waiting
local-update-pending.body: The game folder has an older PanelBridge than this panel's. Update it now, or let the next start copy it in (only while “Keep the panel-installed PanelBridge up to date” is on).

local-not-installed.title: Not installed
local-not-installed.body: PanelBridge isn't installed in this game folder yet.

local-unverified.title: Not confirmed yet
local-unverified.body: PanelBridge hasn't reported in from this server yet. Copy PanelBridge.lua to the server with the setup steps on this tab (or your host's file manager), then restart the server.

local-workshop-loaded.title: Loaded from the Steam Workshop
local-workshop-loaded.body: This server loads PanelBridge from the Steam Workshop, but it's set to panel-installed.
local-workshop-loaded.manualHint: To keep the panel-installed bridge instead, remove {{modId}} from Mods= and the PanelBridge item ID from WorkshopItems= in the server's settings file (Server Config › INI), then restart the server.

workshop-restart-needed.title: Restart needed
workshop-restart-needed.body: Takes effect at the next start. The server downloads about 430 KB from Steam.

workshop-waiting.title: Server started
workshop-waiting.body: Waiting for PanelBridge to report in…

workshop-confirmed.title: Confirmed
workshop-confirmed.body: Loaded from the Steam Workshop: v{{version}}.

workshop-not-loaded.title: Not loaded from the Workshop
workshop-not-loaded.body: The server started, but PanelBridge didn't load from the Workshop.

workshop-stopped.title: Server stopped
workshop-stopped.body: The server is stopped. PanelBridge downloads from the Workshop when it starts.

workshop-start-failed.title: The server didn't start
workshop-start-failed.body: The server stopped while getting PanelBridge from the Steam Workshop.
workshop-start-failed.bodySteamUnreachable: The server couldn't connect to Steam and stopped before downloading anything. Any server in Steam mode stops this way, however PanelBridge is installed.

workshop-id-unknown.title: Workshop item unknown
workshop-id-unknown.body: This panel version doesn't know the PanelBridge Workshop item ID.

causes.notLoaded: Possible causes: the settings were changed outside the panel (restarting from the panel adds the entries back), the server was launched without Steam, or another mod ships media/lua/server/PanelBridge.lua.
causes.startFailed: Possible causes: Steam is down or blocked, or the Workshop item was hidden or removed.
causes.steamUnreachable: Possible causes: Steam is down, or a firewall, proxy or network problem blocks the machine that runs the server. Start it again once Steam can be reached.

state.restartAfterLocalSwitch: The switch to panel-installed takes effect when the server restarts. Until then, it keeps running the PanelBridge it loaded at start.

banner.steamUnavailable: Steam reports the PanelBridge Workshop item as unavailable. The server won't start until it's back or you switch to panel-installed.
banner.autoRestartOn: PanelBridge updates restart this server automatically (Settings › Mods).
banner.autoRestartOff: After each PanelBridge update, new players can't join until you restart. Turn on automatic restarts in Settings › Mods.
banner.leftovers: Old PanelBridge files are still in the game folder: {{files}}. With the Lua integrity check on, players will be refused. Starting or restarting the server from the panel moves them out.

action.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
action.restartWarningNote: Players online get a 5-minute warning first.

confirmRestart.title: Restart {{server}}?
confirmRestart.playersOnline: Players online get a 5-minute warning, then the server restarts.
confirmRestart.nobodyOnline: Nobody is online, so the server restarts right away.
confirmRestart.playersUnknown: The panel can't see who is online right now, so players get a 5-minute warning first, then the server restarts.

dialog.intro: The panel makes these changes, in this order:
dialog.backupNote: A backup of each settings file is saved first.
dialog.blockedTitle: This change isn't available right now
dialog.staleNotice: How PanelBridge is installed on this server changed since you opened this window. Review the updated steps.
dialog.serverChanged: The active server changed, so this window was closed.
dialog.applyRestartPlayers: Switch and restart now (players get a 5-minute warning)

step.iniSet: Set DoLuaChecksum=false in {{file}} (required: with the panel-installed bridge, players can't join while it's on)
step.archiveFile: Move {{file}} out of the game folder (kept in the panel's data folder)
step.archiveFileUnrecognized: Move {{file}} out of the game folder (kept in the panel's data folder; not written by this panel)
step.recordMethodWorkshop: Stop copying PanelBridge into this game folder
step.recordMethodLocal: Copy PanelBridge into this game folder before every start

guided.title: Make these changes on the server
guided.intro: The panel can't change this server's files. Make these changes with your host's file manager, or directly on the machine that runs the server:

toWorkshop.step1: In {{file}}, add {{value}} to the end of the Mods= line.
toWorkshop.step2: Add {{value}} to the end of WorkshopItems= (add the line if it's missing).
toWorkshop.step3: Delete these files from the server's game folder, if you uploaded them:
toWorkshop.step4: Make sure the server isn't started with -nosteam.

toLocal.step1: In {{file}}, remove these PanelBridge entries from the Mods= and WorkshopItems= lines:
toLocal.step2: Upload PanelBridge.lua to media/lua/server/ in the server's game folder.

guided.keepChecksumOff: Leave DoLuaChecksum=false until this page confirms the switch.

checksumOffer.title: Turn the Lua integrity check back on?
checksumOffer.body: PanelBridge now loads from the Steam Workshop, so the Lua integrity check can be turned back on.
checksumOffer.ackNonAdmin: I'll test with a normal player account. Admin accounts skip this check, so an admin getting in doesn't prove it works.
checksumOffer.ackLinux: Earlier game builds (41.77, 42.13–42.14) refused Windows and Mac players on Linux servers with this check on, even with identical files. It isn't confirmed fixed on this build. If players can't join, turn it off here.
checksumOffer.ackLinuxGuided: Earlier game builds (41.77, 42.13–42.14) refused Windows and Mac players on Linux servers with this check on, even with identical files. It isn't confirmed fixed on this build. If players can't join, set DoLuaChecksum=false in the server's .ini file again and restart the server.
checksumOffer.ackRemoteFiles: I deleted the PanelBridge files I uploaded to the server's game folder.
checksumOffer.turnOn: Turn on the Lua integrity check…
checksumOffer.isOn: The Lua integrity check is on.
checksumOffer.onUnconfirmedBody: PanelBridge isn't confirmed to load from the Steam Workshop yet. If it still loads from the game folder, players can't join with this check on.
checksumOffer.guidedInstructions: Set DoLuaChecksum=true in the server's .ini file, then restart the server.
checksumOffer.guidedTurnOffHint: The panel can't read this server's settings file. If you turned the check on and players are refused, set DoLuaChecksum=false in the server's .ini file and restart the server.
checksumOffer.needsServerFiles: Changing DoLuaChecksum requires the serverfiles.manage permission, which this role doesn't have.
checksumOffer.restartPrompt: DoLuaChecksum=true is saved. It takes effect when the server restarts.
checksumOffer.noLongerAvailable: This server's status changed, so the check wasn't turned on. Review this page and try again.

blockers.notWorkshop: Only available with Steam Workshop delivery.
blockers.notConfirmed: Wait until this page confirms PanelBridge loads from the Steam Workshop.
blockers.looseFilesPresent: Old PanelBridge files are still in the game folder. Start or restart the server from the panel to move them out first.
blockers.alreadyOn: The Lua integrity check is already on.

toast.switchedToWorkshop: {{server}} now gets PanelBridge from the Steam Workshop
toast.switchedToLocal: The panel now installs PanelBridge on {{server}}
toast.guidedRecorded: Saved. This page confirms the change once PanelBridge reports in from {{server}}.
toast.switchFailed: Couldn't change how PanelBridge is installed
toast.notRestored: The panel couldn't undo every change it had already made. Before starting the server, check its settings file in Server Config › INI; a backup of it was saved before the change.
toast.notRestoredFile: Couldn't change {{fileName}}, and the panel couldn't undo every change it had already made. Before starting the server, check its settings file in Server Config › INI; a backup of it was saved before the change.
toast.lifecycleFailed: Switched, but the server didn't start or restart
toast.lifecycleSkipped: Switched, but the active server changed meanwhile, so {{server}} wasn't started or restarted.
toast.installed: PanelBridge is up to date in the game folder
toast.installFailed: Couldn't copy PanelBridge into the game folder
toast.checksumOff: DoLuaChecksum=false saved. Restart the server to apply it.

setupNote.workshop: This server gets PanelBridge from the Steam Workshop, so there's nothing to upload. Keep DoLuaChecksum=false until “How PanelBridge is installed” above confirms the switch.
setupNote.waitingWorkshop: The panel is ready. When the PZ server starts, it downloads PanelBridge from the Steam Workshop and reports in once the world has loaded. See “How PanelBridge is installed” above.

mods.badgeTooltip: Managed in Settings › PanelBridge. Switch to panel-installed there to remove it.
